meta.title: Disputes about the Constitutional Tribunal since 2015
meta.note: Each event is attributed to its source; no event is presented as the cause of another.

events.event: Act on the Constitutional Tribunal of 25 June 2015 (Dz.U. 2015 poz. 1064)
events.description: Replaced the 1997 Act. Art. 137 let the outgoing Sejm nominate candidates for judges whose terms ended in 2015 within 30 days of entry into force.

events.event: Sejm of the 7th term elects five judges
events.description: Hauser, Jakubecki, Ślebzak (three seats expiring 6 Nov 2015) and Sitek, Sokala (seats expiring 2 and 8 Dec 2015), per the Tribunal's communiqué of 29 Feb 2016. Resolutions published in M.P. on 23 Oct 2015 (poz. 1038-1042).

events.event: Amendment of the Act on the Tribunal
events.description: Ustawa of 19 Nov 2015 (Dz.U. 2015 poz. 1928).

events.event: Sejm of the 8th term finds the five October resolutions without legal force
events.description: Five resolutions (M.P. 2015 poz. 1131-1135); the Sejm asks the President to refrain from taking the oath of the persons named.

events.event: Sejm of the 8th term elects five judges
events.description: Cioch, Morawski, Muszyński, Pszczółkowski, Przyłębska (M.P. 2015 poz. 1182-1186).

events.event: President takes the oath of four judges elected on 2 December
events.description: Cioch, Morawski, Muszyński and Pszczółkowski, at the Presidential Palace.

events.event: Judgment K 34/15
events.description: On the 2015 Act: the President must take the oath of a judge elected by the Sejm without delay; the election of 8 Oct 2015 was constitutional for the three seats expiring 6 Nov 2015 and unconstitutional for the two expiring 2 and 8 Dec 2015.

events.event: President takes the oath of Julia Przyłębska
events.description: Fifth judge elected on 2 December.

events.event: Judgment K 35/15
events.description: On the amendment of 19 Nov 2015 (Dz.U. 2015 poz. 2147).

events.event: Presidential minister: the President will not take the oath of the judges elected on 8 October
events.description: Minister Dera said the resolutions 'do not exist in law' and that K 34/15 changed nothing.

events.event: Further amendment of the Act on the Tribunal
events.description: Ustawa of 22 Dec 2015 (Dz.U. 2015 poz. 2217).

events.event: Tribunal's Office explains the 2015 elections, the two amendments and the case law
events.description: Communiqué on the October and December 2015 elections.

events.event: Judgment K 47/15 on the Act as amended
events.description: Published in Dz.U. only on 5 June 2018 (poz. 1077).

events.event: Venice Commission opinion on the amendments to the Act of 25 June 2015
events.description: Opinion CDL-AD(2016)001, adopted 11-12 March 2016 at the Polish Foreign Minister's request. The Commission later quoted its own finding that the amendments of 22 December 2015 'would have endangered not only the rule of law, but also the functioning of the democratic system' (para. 137).

events.event: New Act on the Tribunal
events.description: Ustawa of 22 July 2016 (Dz.U. 2016 poz. 1157).

events.event: Judgment K 39/16 on the Act of 22 July 2016
events.description: Published in Dz.U. only on 5 June 2018 (poz. 1078).

events.event: Venice Commission opinion on the Act on the Constitutional Tribunal (22 July 2016)
events.description: Opinion CDL-AD(2016)026, adopted 14-15 October 2016. The Commission also condemned the Prime Minister's refusal to publish Tribunal judgments (paras. 126-127, as cited in its 2024 opinion).

events.event: Three acts: on the status of judges, on organisation and procedure, and introductory provisions
events.description: Ustawy of 30 Nov 2016 (Dz.U. 2016 poz. 2072-2074); the status Act (poz. 2073) governs the oath.

events.event: President appoints Julia Przyłębska President of the Tribunal
events.description: Dated 21 Dec 2016 on the President's site. The Venice Commission's 2024 opinion says she was appointed 'acting President' on 20 Dec 2016 under the new Act, admitted the three December 2015 judges to the bench the same day, and was sworn in shortly after. The Sejm resolution of 6 March 2024 disputes the choice (no prior General Assembly resolution).

events.event: Sejm elects Justyn Piskorski; Act on the status of judges amended
Judgment K 1/17
events.description: Declared constitutional the provisions of the introductory Act on assigning cases to all judges who had taken the oath before the President, including the December 2015 judges (as described in CDL-AD(2024)035).

events.event: European Court of Human Rights: Xero Flor v Poland (no. 4907/18)
events.description: Unanimous finding of a violation of Article 6 § 1 (tribunal established by law) because the election of a judge on the panel was vitiated by grave irregularities. The judgment pseudonymises the judges: the five elected on 2 Dec 2015 appear as H.C., L.M., M.M., P.P. and J.P.; the oath of four was received on the night of 2-3 December and of J.P. on 9 December. Final 7 Aug 2021.

events.event: Judgment P 7/20 (interim measures of the Court of Justice of the EU)
events.description: Cited by the Commission in C-448/23 and by the Venice Commission as denying the binding effect of interim measures ordered by the CJEU.

events.event: Judgment K 3/21 (Article 19(1) TEU)
events.description: Declared the CJEU's interpretation of Article 19(1) TEU, on national courts reviewing judicial appointments, incompatible with the Constitution (as described in CDL-AD(2024)035).

events.event: Judgment K 6/21 (Article 6 ECHR)
events.description: Declared the first sentence of Article 6(1) of the Convention incompatible with the Constitution as far as 'tribunal' gave the ECtHR jurisdiction to review the election of Tribunal judges (as described in CDL-AD(2024)035).

events.event: Council of Europe Secretary General asks Poland, under Article 52 of the Convention, how its law ensures implementation of the Convention
events.description: Letter to the Foreign Minister, as cited in CDL-AD(2024)035. The letter itself is not read.

events.event: European Commission refers Poland to the Court of Justice
events.description: Press release of 15 Feb 2023 cited in CDL-AD(2024)035 n. 15; became case C-448/23. The press release itself is not read.

events.event: European Court of Human Rights: M.L. v Poland (no. 40119/21)
events.description: Violation of Article 8 (five votes to two): the interference came from a Constitutional Tribunal ruling whose bench included judges appointed in a procedure the Court had already found in breach of the Convention in Xero Flor, so it was not 'lawful'. The press release notes that the President had refused to swear in three judges legally elected in October 2015. Read from the Court's press release (ECHR 354 (2023)); the judgment text itself is not read.
events.document: ECtHR press release ECHR 354 (2023); M.L. v Poland, no. 40119/21

events.event: Government announces an Action Plan to restore the rule of law, including a Sejm resolution and amendments to the Act on the Tribunal
events.description: February 2024, after the October 2023 parliamentary elections (CDL-AD(2024)035 para. 14).

events.event: Sejm resolution 'on removing the effects of the constitutional crisis of 2015-2023'
events.description: States that the resolutions electing Sitek, Sokala, Muszyński, Cioch, Morawski, Piskorski and Wyrembak (and the three 25 Nov 2015 findings) are without legal effect; that Muszyński, Piskorski and Wyrembak are not judges; and that the President of the Tribunal is unauthorised. A statement of one institution's position.

events.event: Judgment U 5/24 on the Sejm resolution of 6 March 2024
events.description: Held the resolution (M.P. 2024 poz. 198) incompatible with arts. 7, 10, 173, 87(1) and 190(1) of the Constitution; unanimous; three judges (Święczkowski, Piotrowicz, Sochański). The Venice Commission records that the government afterwards stopped publishing the Tribunal's judgments (para. 14).

events.event: Venice Commission opinion on draft constitutional amendments and two laws on the Tribunal
events.description: Opinion CDL-AD(2024)035 (adopted 6-7 Dec 2024, at the Minister of Justice's request). It says 12 of the 15 sitting judges were elected under the constitutional procedure and cannot be removed by complete renewal; that the three irregularly appointed judges should withdraw from pending cases; and that just over 100 judgments are affected.

events.event: Bogdan Święczkowski appointed President of the Tribunal
events.description: Appointed by President Duda on 9 Dec 2024; the same day marks the end of the terms of Przyłębska, Muszyński and Pszczółkowski in the Tribunal's own roster.

events.event: Two seats fall vacant (5 and 20 December 2025)
events.description: Per the Chancellery (1 Apr 2026) two vacancies arose in December 2025; the roster shows the terms of Pawłowicz (5 Dec) and Warciński (20 Dec) ending.

events.event: Court of Justice of the EU: Commission v Poland (C-448/23)
events.description: Grand Chamber upheld the Commission's action: the Tribunal's judgments of 14 July and 7 Oct 2021 infringed EU law; and the appointments of three judges (December 2015) and its President (December 2016) were vitiated by infringements of fundamental appointment rules, so the Tribunal does not meet the requirements of an independent and impartial tribunal established by law within the meaning of EU law. Read from the Court's press release no. 157/25.

events.event: Sejm elects six judges and adopts a resolution on the 2015 judges
events.description: Bentkowska, Dziurda, Korwin-Piotrowska, Markiewicz, Szostek, Taborowski (M.P. 2026 poz. 300-305). Resolution poz. 299 states Hauser, Jakubecki and Ślebzak were validly elected in 2015 and unlawfully prevented from taking office.

events.event: Tribunal: the Sejm may state positions in resolutions but not assess the status of another constitutional organ
events.description: Statement on the Sejm resolution of the same day (page dated 13 Mar 2026).

events.event: President takes the oath of two of the six judges
events.description: Bentkowska and Szostek, in the presence of the President of the Tribunal.

events.event: Four judges say the oath in the Sejm without the President; the Chancellery rejects it
events.description: Dziurda, Korwin-Piotrowska, Markiewicz and Taborowski. The Chancellery says 'before the President' means in his presence; the Marshal of the Sejm considered the oath valid; the President announces a competence dispute. The Sejm's own communiqués are not yet read (bot wall).

events.event: President's application to resolve a competence dispute with the Sejm (Kpt 1/26)
events.description: Filed with the Tribunal on 27 April 2026 (entered 29 April). Asks whether the power to take the oath personally is the President's alone, whether the Sejm may organise or legitimise acts meant to replace it, and whether the Sejm event of 9 April 2026 could have produced legal effects. The Tribunal's portal lists the Prosecutor General and the Sejm as participants and the case as pending at 31 Oct 2026, with no hearing or ruling.

events.event: European Court of Human Rights grants an interim measure in 'Dziurda and Others v Poland'
events.description: The Court provisionally granted an interim measure in the case of four legal professionals elected on 13 March 2026 as judges of the Constitutional Court who have not been allowed to take up their duties. The terms of the measure and the stage of the case are in the press release, which is not read.

events.event: Judgment K 3/26 on the President's duty to take the oath
events.description: Held art. 4(1) of the 2016 status Act, read as imposing on the President a duty to take the oath of anyone the Sejm elects, incompatible with arts. 126 and 2 of the Constitution. Five-judge bench (Święczkowski, Piskorski, Sochański, Wojciechowski, Wyrembak); Wojciechowski and Wyrembak dissented. The Sejm resolution of 6 March 2024 holds Piskorski and Wyrembak are not judges.

events.event: Tribunal tells the Ministry of Foreign Affairs its position in the proceedings before the ECtHR brought by four elected judges
events.description: The President of the Tribunal says the four are not judges because they did not take the oath before the President; a competence dispute between the President and the Sejm is pending before the Tribunal.

events.event: Tribunal sends the ECtHR its position in 'Dziurda and Others v Poland'
events.description: The President of the Tribunal says the four are not judges because they did not take the oath before the President; the competence dispute is pending.

events.event: General Assembly of Judges does not meet
events.description: The Tribunal says Markiewicz and Dziurda, brought into the room by Bentkowska and Szostek, are unauthorised under art. 6 of the Act; the President of the Tribunal and other judges leave; no quorum.

events.event: Patyra takes the oath before the President
events.description: Elected 11 June 2026.

events.event: Sejm elects Maciej Berek
Venice Commission opinion on the powers of the President in the context of the oath
events.description: Opinion CDL-AD(2026)031 (13 Oct 2026). The text could not be fetched (access refused), so its content is not recorded here. The Chancellery (14 Oct) responds to it.

events.event: Berek says the oath in the Sejm and is brought into the Tribunal's building; the Chancellery objects
events.description: The Chief of the Chancellery calls it troubling that services under the Interior Minister were used to bring in a person who had not completed the procedure; the President went to the Tribunal and cancelled a trip abroad.

events.event: President in an interview: Berek is not a judge
events.description: Says Berek did not take the oath before the President and that the Chancellery asked for documents showing ten years as a legal adviser.

events.event: Tribunal: a statement by three judges is passed to the disciplinary spokesperson and added to the Kpt 1/26 file
events.description: The President of the Tribunal's decision; the statement itself is not read.

events.event: President's letter to the President of the Tribunal about Berek
events.description: Reported to say that no service relationship arose. News reports only; the letter is not found on an official site.

events.event: The Tribunal's own list of judgments not published in Dziennik Ustaw, 2024-2026
events.description: The Tribunal lists 85 judgments of 2024-2026 (22 of 2024, 41 of 2025, 22 of 2026) as unpublished, including U 5/24 (28 May 2024) and K 3/26 (12 May 2026). The list is the Tribunal's; the date is when it was read. See tables/unpublished_judgments.csv.
